title: The Multimillionaire Blueprint
subtitle: From Ordinary Thinking to Extraordinary Wealth
description:
Wealth is built, not wished for.

Working hard and becoming wealthy are not the same thing. Millions of people rise early, work with dedication and still struggle to build lasting security. The difference is rarely the hours they work. It is how they understand value, ownership, opportunity, risk and time.

The Multimillionaire Blueprint is a complete, practical system for building, scaling and preserving wealth with intelligence and integrity. In six parts and thirty chapters, Dr. S. Davidraj takes you from the psychology of a wealthy mind to the power of compounding, and from an ordinary idea to a business, a portfolio and a legacy that lasts.

Inside this book:
• Why income is not wealth and what truly builds net worth
• The five foundations of extraordinary wealth
• How to turn an ordinary idea into a valuable business
• Leverage, AI and global markets as engines of growth
• A ten-year plan to build, protect and pass on your wealth
